006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.DecimalAdapter;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDecimalItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.ITimeItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019
020import java.math.BigDecimal;
021import java.time.Duration;
022import java.util.List;
023
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025
026/**
027 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
028 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-seconds-from-time">fn:seconds-from-time</a>.
029 * function.
030 */
031public final class FnSecondsFromTime {
032  private static final String NAME = "seconds-from-time";
033  @NonNull
034  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
035      .name(NAME)
036      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
037      .deterministic()
038      .contextIndependent()
039      .focusIndependent()
040      .argument(IArgument.builder()
041          .name("arg")
042          .type(ITimeItem.type())
043          .zeroOrOne()
044          .build())
045      .returnType(IDecimalItem.type())
046      .returnZeroOrOne()
047      .functionHandler(FnSecondsFromTime::execute)
048      .build();
049
050  private FnSecondsFromTime() {
051    // disable construction
052  }
053
054  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
055  @NonNull
056  private static ISequence<IDecimalItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
057      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
058      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
059      IItem focus) {
060    ITimeItem arg = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
061    return arg == null
062        // Per spec, return empty sequence if the arg is null
063        ? ISequence.empty()
064        : ISequence.of(fnSecondsFromTime(arg));
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Implements <a href=
069   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-seconds-from-time">fn:seconds-from-time</a>.
070   *
071   * @param arg
072   *          the meta:time item from which to extract the second component
073   * @return the second component from the date as a decimal item
074   */
075  @NonNull
076  public static IDecimalItem fnSecondsFromTime(@NonNull ITimeItem arg) {
077    Duration duration = Duration.ofSeconds(arg.getSecond(), arg.getNano());
078    return IDecimalItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(
079        BigDecimal.valueOf(duration.getSeconds())
080            .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(duration.getNano())
081                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(1_000_000_000.0), DecimalAdapter.mathContext()))));
082  }
083}
